units: positions in mm and in LDU (2.5 LDU per mm), in the part's own frame
frame: origin at the product centre; -Y out of the screen, +Y out of the back; +X toward the side-button edge; +Z toward the top (receiver) end

extent.note: Y runs from the screen to the top of the lens rings (7.31 + 0.87)

window.note: centre of the lens window, drawn flush with the ring top (its depth is not given)

coneApex.source: derived: sheet 1, Detail D: 2.00 CONE TO BACK GLASS, from the 7.31 front: 7.31 - 2.00
coneApex.note: the keepout cone's apex: the drawing's own optical reference; the lens's entrance pupil is near it but not given

keepoutCone.source: dimensioned: sheet 1, Detail D: 76.7° REAR CAMERA KEEPOUT CONE
keepoutCone.note: nothing of a mount may enter this cone from its apex: a design check, not the field of view

fieldOfView.source: derived from third-party: the Wide's 35 mm equivalent focal length as its photos' EXIF records it (3.99 mm, 28 mm equivalent); Apple's specifications give none
fieldOfView.note: pinhole model of the 4:3 still; the image's long side runs along the phone's length (Z). Video (16:9) crops the short side

sources.fromSide: dimensioned: sheet 1, back view: 10.44 (the camera's centre, from the side-button edge)
sources.fromTop: dimensioned: sheet 1, back view: 3X 10.24 (the camera's, the rear mic's and the flash's centres, from the top)

cameras.identity: inferred: the only rear camera: the 12MP Wide (spec); its 76.7° cone encloses a 28 mm lens's 75.4° diagonal

apexFromFront.source: derived: sheet 1, Detail D: 1.35 CONE TO BACK GLASS (the 114° cone's apex inside it), from the 7.31 front: 7.31 - 1.35

innerConeDeg.source: dimensioned: sheet 1, Detail D: 114° FLASH KEEPOUT CONE UNDER 1.44 mm

outerConeDeg.source: dimensioned: sheet 1, Detail D: 158° FLASH KEEPOUT CONE BEYOND 1.44 mm
